name: PageShell
summary: The frame of a page: a skip link first, then a header, the navigation column, one main, an aside and a footer, each in its landmark. Under breakpoint.tablet the navigation moves to a Drawer behind a menu button.
useWhen: The outer frame of an app or a site page, once per page
A page with a side navigation (Sidebar or Rail) that must fold away on phones
Any page that needs the landmarks and the skip link set up the same way everywhere
avoidWhen: A part of a page: a card, a panel or a form section
A second frame inside a page that already has one, except as a preview with embedded
Side by side list and detail inside main

parts.Drawer: the navigation on narrow screens and while the column is hidden (outside the root, in a portal)

header.description: The top bar: a Navbar, or a brand and actions. In the header landmark (banner).

nav.description: A Sidebar or a Rail, each its own labelled nav landmark. The nav part is a plain element around it.

aside.description: Secondary content next to main. Under breakpoint.desktop it goes under main.

asideLabel.description: The name of the aside landmark. Arabic default: تفاصيل إضافية.

mainId.description: The id of main and the skip link target. One per page.

skipLabel.description: The skip link text. Arabic default from SkipLink: الانتقال للمحتوى الرئيسي.

sidebar.description: The column state on wide screens, controlled, with onSidebarChange. Under breakpoint.tablet the root always says hidden.

menuLabel.description: The menu button's name. Arabic default: فتح التنقل.

drawerTitle.description: The title of the navigation Drawer. Arabic default: التنقل.

embedded.description: A preview of a page inside another page (a gallery, docs, a template picker): the same frame with no landmarks; main becomes a region named Main content.

a11y.role: No role on the root. header is the banner, main the main landmark (one per page, id main), aside a complementary landmark with a label, footer the contentinfo. The navigation landmark is the Sidebar or Rail inside the nav part.
a11y.focus: The skip link is the first tab stop; Enter moves focus to main. The menu button opens the navigation Drawer, and focus returns to it when the Drawer closes.

keys.Tab: The first press reaches the skip link, then the menu button (only while the column is hidden), the header, the navigation, main, the aside and the footer in that order
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves back through the same order
keys.Enter: On the skip link, moves focus to main

a11y.announce: Landmarks carry the names a screen reader lists: the Sidebar or Rail label, the aside label.
notes: The reading order equals the visual order in every width: header, navigation, main, aside, footer.

Under breakpoint.tablet the column is not rendered, so its links are never in the page twice; the Drawer renders them while open. A media query hides the column from the first paint, before hydration.
A click on a link inside the navigation Drawer closes it, so a client routed page does not open under it.
While the column is hidden on a wide screen (sidebar hidden), the menu button and the Drawer are the way to the navigation, as on phones.
No motion: the column swaps at once. The Drawer brings its own motion (pattern sheet).
The shell takes the height of its parent (min-block-size 100%). Give html and body a height for a full screen frame; no viewport height token exists yet.

en.asideLabel: A noun phrase that names the content: Board details, Filters.
en.skipLabel: Skip to main content, or name the target: Skip to the board list.

react.note: Renders SkipLink, IconButton and Drawer. The hook usePageShell() shares the column state: { sidebar, wideSidebar, setSidebar, narrow, setDrawerOpen }. Pass collapsed={sidebar === 'collapsed'} and onCollapsedChange to the Sidebar so its toggle and the shell agree.

angular.note: Content projection into the same parts.

native.note: Native apps use navigation stacks and tab bars from the router, not a page frame with landmarks.

styles.studio: No recipe: the page color with 1px lines between the regions, the compact header at the large control height.
styles.desk: No recipe: the same frame on the Desk page color. Desk apps usually live in Windows, not in a PageShell.
styles.neutral: Tokens only: the Neutral page color and borders.
styles.liquid: Planned: the header and navigation may float on glass over scrolling content.

mistakes.wrong: Two PageShells on one page, or a PageShell inside main
mistakes.right: One per page; previews inside a page use embedded

mistakes.wrong: A nav element around the Sidebar
mistakes.right: Pass the Sidebar as nav: it is the labelled nav landmark itself

mistakes.wrong: Hiding the Sidebar on phones with display none and no other way in
mistakes.right: PageShell moves it to a Drawer behind the menu button

mistakes.wrong: A Sidebar with its own collapsed state that the shell does not know
mistakes.right: Wire collapsed and onCollapsedChange to usePageShell()

mistakes.wrong: A main id other than the skip link target
